events.title: Tencent releases WeVisOne-VL weights for unified visual perception
events.title_zh: Tencent 发布 WeVisOne-VL 统一视觉感知权重
events.summary: Tencent released WeVisOne-VL 2B and 4B model weights plus a required 9.6M-parameter pixel decoder for detection, referring localization, counting, point grounding, OCR, segmentation and alpha matting. The Hugging Face repositories are ungated and list Apache-2.0, while the GitHub detector does not expose a detected license. Published benchmarks are vendor-reported.
events.summary_en: Tencent released WeVisOne-VL 2B and 4B model weights plus a required 9.6M-parameter pixel decoder for detection, referring localization, counting, point grounding, OCR, segmentation and alpha matting. The Hugging Face repositories are ungated and list Apache-2.0, while the GitHub detector does not expose a detected license. Published benchmarks are vendor-reported.
events.summary_zh: Tencent 公开 WeVisOne-VL 2B、4B 权重和必需的 960 万参数 pixel decoder，统一支持检测、指代表达定位、计数、point grounding、OCR、分割与 alpha matting。Hugging Face 仓库无需申请并标为 Apache-2.0，但 GitHub 尚未识别出许可证。公开 benchmark 均来自发布方。
events.why_it_matters: For teams that currently chain separate vision models, one open-weight interface may simplify experimentation and deployment. The broad task surface also raises evaluation risk: license notices, pixel-decoder packaging and accuracy on local images require independent checks.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams that currently chain separate vision models, one open-weight interface may simplify experimentation and deployment. The broad task surface also raises evaluation risk: license notices, pixel-decoder packaging and accuracy on local images require independent checks.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对目前串联多个视觉模型的团队来说，统一的开放权重接口可能减少实验和部署复杂度。任务跨度很大也增加了评测风险：第三方许可、pixel decoder 打包和真实图片准确率都需要独立核对。

technical_details.tasks: open-vocabulary detection, referring localization, counting, point grounding, OCR, referring segmentation and alpha matting
technical_details.availability: ungated Hugging Face weights and public inference code
technical_details.license_boundary: model cards list Apache-2.0; GitHub license detector reports NOASSERTION, so inspect included third-party notices
technical_details.time_basis: public GitHub release commit at 2026-10-23T08:14:47Z; Hugging Face repositories expose date-only creation evidence

technical_details_zh.任务: 开放词汇检测、指代表达定位、计数、point grounding、OCR、指代分割、alpha matting
technical_details_zh.可用性: 无需申请的 Hugging Face 权重与公开推理代码
technical_details_zh.许可边界: model card 标为 Apache-2.0；GitHub 未识别出许可证，需核对第三方 notices
technical_details_zh.时间依据: GitHub 公开提交为 2026-10-23T08:14:47Z；Hugging Face 仓库只有日期精度

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用 30 张自有图片对比现有检测与分割链路，记录召回率、延迟、显存和第三方许可清单。
events.next_action_en: In one day, compare it with the current detection and segmentation pipeline on 30 local images, recording recall, latency, memory and third-party licenses.
